Question: Do you offer private services or closed group trips?
Other ways to ask: Can I book a private or exclusive trip just for my group? / Is there an option for diving only with my group and no other people?
Answer: Yes, private services and closed group trips can be organized, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). An advisor from the team will prepare a quote and coordinate an available instructor for the requested date.

Question: Which plan do you recommend based on my diving experience?
Other ways to ask: Which option is best for me? / What do you offer for certified divers or beginners?
Answer: The recommendation depends on your experience and what you're looking for: if you are a certified diver, there are recreational dive trips and packages for different levels; if you are a beginner, you can choose the scuba minicourse (Discover Scuba); we also offer PADI courses and snorkeling tours. An advisor from the team can guide you to the most suitable plan for your profile.

[2] Fuente: faqs
Question: Can mixed groups (certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers) join the same tour?
Other ways to ask: Can a group with certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers do activities together on the same day? / Is it possible to mix certified divers, mini-course participants, and snorkelers in one tour?
Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine different activities in one tour. Groups can include certified divers, people who want to do the mini-course, and those who only want to snorkel. While certified divers do their first dive or snorkelers do their first activity, mini-course participants do their theory and pool training. On the second dive, if they wish, they can join the mini-course participants for the open water dive. In groups that combine diving and snorkeling, snorkeling is done in a different area from diving. If there are few people, they go together in the same boat; otherwise, they are divided by activity. More info: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

Other ways to ask: Do you split snorkelers and divers? / Where do snorkelers go if I'm with divers?
Answer: In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.

[2] Fuente: faqs
Question: Can mixed groups (certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers) join the same tour?
Other ways to ask: Can a group with certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers do activities together on the same day? / Is it possible to mix certified divers, mini-course participants, and snorkelers in one tour?
Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine different activities in one tour. Groups can include certified divers, people who want to do the mini-course, and those who only want to snorkel. While certified divers do their first dive or snorkelers do their first activity, mini-course participants do their theory and pool training. On the second dive, if they wish, they can join the mini-course participants for the open water dive. In groups that combine diving and snorkeling, snorkeling is done in a different area from diving. If there are few people, they go together in the same boat; otherwise, they are divided by activity. More info: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

[3] Fuente: faqs
Question: On the 2-dive trip, do we dive at the same site? How long is each dive?
Other ways to ask: Are the two dives at different spots? / How long do you stay underwater on each dive? / Does it cost more to dive at two different sites?
Answer: The 2 dives are done at two different dive sites. If the day's conditions require changing the site, the instructor decides on the day. Each dive lasts 40 to 50 minutes. The price doesn't change for diving at different sites: it is included in the plan price.

[4] Fuente: faqs
Question: Which plan do you recommend based on my diving experience?
Other ways to ask: Which option is best for me? / What do you offer for certified divers or beginners?
Answer: The recommendation depends on your experience and what you're looking for: if you are a certified diver, there are recreational dive trips and packages for different levels; if you are a beginner, you can choose the scuba minicourse (Discover Scuba); we also offer PADI courses and snorkeling tours. An advisor from the team can guide you to the most suitable plan for your profile.

Question: Can I do an extra dive in addition to my package?
Other ways to ask: Is it possible to add an extra dive to my diving package? / Can I do an additional dive if I already have a package?
Answer: There is an option to add an extra dive, but in practice there is almost never enough time within the boat schedule to do so. It is not available at all from Cartagena for this same reason. Actual availability must be confirmed by a team advisor before assuming it is possible.

[6] Fuente: faqs
Question: Can I do just 1 dive from Cartagena?
Other ways to ask: Is it possible to book just one dive departing from Cartagena? / Do you offer the option of a single dive from Cartagena?
Answer: From Cartagena, the minimum is 2 dives (a full-day trip), as the boat logistics and trip timing do not allow for a single dive. The option for just one dive is only available if you are already on the Rosario Islands, or in exceptional cases depending on availability, which is coordinated by a team advisor.

Question: Are snorkeling and diving groups together on the boat?
Other ways to ask: Do you split snorkelers and divers? / Where do snorkelers go if I'm with divers?
Answer: In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.

[2] Fuente: faqs
Question: Can mixed groups (certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers) join the same tour?
Other ways to ask: Can a group with certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers do activities together on the same day? / Is it possible to mix certified divers, mini-course participants, and snorkelers in one tour?
Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine different activities in one tour. Groups can include certified divers, people who want to do the mini-course, and those who only want to snorkel. While certified divers do their first dive or snorkelers do their first activity, mini-course participants do their theory and pool training. On the second dive, if they wish, they can join the mini-course participants for the open water dive. In groups that combine diving and snorkeling, snorkeling is done in a different area from diving. If there are few people, they go together in the same boat; otherwise, they are divided by activity. More info: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

[3] Fuente: faqs
Question: On the 2-dive trip, do we dive at the same site? How long is each dive?
Other ways to ask: Are the two dives at different spots? / How long do you stay underwater on each dive? / Does it cost more to dive at two different sites?
Answer: The 2 dives are done at two different dive sites. If the day's conditions require changing the site, the instructor decides on the day. Each dive lasts 40 to 50 minutes. The price doesn't change for diving at different sites: it is included in the plan price.

[4] Fuente: faqs
Question: Which plan do you recommend based on my diving experience?
Other ways to ask: Which option is best for me? / What do you offer for certified divers or beginners?
Answer: The recommendation depends on your experience and what you're looking for: if you are a certified diver, there are recreational dive trips and packages for different levels; if you are a beginner, you can choose the scuba minicourse (Discover Scuba); we also offer PADI courses and snorkeling tours. An advisor from the team can guide you to the most suitable plan for your profile.

[5] Fuente: faqs
Question: Can I do an extra dive in addition to my package?
Other ways to ask: Is it possible to add an extra dive to my diving package? / Can I do an additional dive if I already have a package?
Answer: There is an option to add an extra dive, but in practice there is almost never enough time within the boat schedule to do so. It is not available at all from Cartagena for this same reason. Actual availability must be confirmed by a team advisor before assuming it is possible.

[6] Fuente: faqs
Question: Can I do just 1 dive from Cartagena?
Other ways to ask: Is it possible to book just one dive departing from Cartagena? / Do you offer the option of a single dive from Cartagena?
Answer: From Cartagena, the minimum is 2 dives (a full-day trip), as the boat logistics and trip timing do not allow for a single dive. The option for just one dive is only available if you are already on the Rosario Islands, or in exceptional cases depending on availability, which is coordinated by a team advisor.

[7] Fuente: faqs
Question: It's my first time diving. What do you recommend?
Other ways to ask: I've never dived before, which activity should I choose? / What is the best option for beginner divers?
Answer: The Dive Mini Course (introductory dive) is recommended for first-time divers. It includes a theory section to be completed before the activity, pool practice, and one open water dive with an instructor. No prior experience or certification is required. More information: https://divingplanet.org/tours-buceo-snorkel-cartagena/minicurso-principiantes/

[8] Fuente: faqs
Question: Do the 5, 7, or 9 dive packages require certification?
Other ways to ask: Can I book the 5, 7, or 9 dive package if I'm not certified? / Is certification required for the 5, 7, or 9 dive packages?
Answer: Yes. The 5, 7, and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners. If you do not have certification but want to do multiple dives, you must first complete the Open Water course.

Question: Can mixed groups (certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers) join the same tour?
Other ways to ask: Can a group with certified divers, beginners, and snorkelers do activities together on the same day? / Is it possible to mix certified divers, mini-course participants, and snorkelers in one tour?
Answer: Yes, it is possible to combine different activities in one tour. Groups can include certified divers, people who want to do the mini-course, and those who only want to snorkel. While certified divers do their first dive or snorkelers do their first activity, mini-course participants do their theory and pool training. On the second dive, if they wish, they can join the mini-course participants for the open water dive. In groups that combine diving and snorkeling, snorkeling is done in a different area from diving. If there are few people, they go together in the same boat; otherwise, they are divided by activity. More info: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

Answer: As a general reference, the Open Water course allows diving up to 18 meters, Advanced Open Water up to 30 meters, and the Deep Specialty up to 40 meters, always within recreational limits. At greater depths, air consumption increases, no-decompression limits decrease, and nitrogen narcosis may occur. Narcosis is an effect of nitrogen at depth that can affect perception, judgment, and reaction. Deep diving increases complexity and risk, so it requires training, planning, and respecting established limits.
